title: Regal Air
specs: Over 33 years as top Flightseeing and Bear Viewing company in Alaska

services.name: Fishing trips
services.desc: We have been helping travelers and businesses with air charter, air taxi, and remote logistics in Alaska since our start in 1982. We have a fleet of well maintained and dependable DeHavilland Beaver and Cessna 206 aircraft to help you with whatever your charter needs may be. We fly our aircraft out of Lake Hood airport and Ted Stevens International Airport. Lake Hood is the busiest seaplane base in the world, located right in Anchorage. Whatever your air taxi or air charter needs may be, Regal Air knows the remote areas of Alaska and can help in your logistics planning. Regal Air operates our Air Charters year round, with floatplanes during the summer season, ski planes during the winter

services.name: Alaska Boat Cruises
services.desc: Boat Cruises are another popular way to see all that Alaska has to offer. With several different companies offering several different tours you should have no trouble finding one that suits both your schedule and your budget. On these cruises you can expect to see wildlife as well as glaciers, and many stop at Lodges

blurb: Regal Air offers flightseeing tours to view Alaska's spectacular scenery and bear viewing adventures out of Anchorage. They also provide year-round air taxi and aircraft charters. The company has operated since 1982 with a strong safety record.
highlights: Over 33 years as top Flightseeing and Bear Viewing company in Alaska

quotes.text: I would highly recommend Regal Air. We flew with them on a day trip to Katmai NP. Our pilot Brett was super friendly and knowledgeable. He paid close attention to the weather and navigated it carefully to ensure we could travel safely. He also did a very nice job pointing out some highlights of the beautiful scenery on each ~2 hr leg of the plane ride. Brett’s communication skills were great - he made it clear how much time we had, where to meet, and indicated flight plan adjustments to us well. I would fly with Regal Air again!

Highly recommend! Super professional outfit and amazing customer service. We flew with Regal Air for a fly in river trip this July and have done a lot of fly ins across AK over the years and I was very impressed with Regal and really trusted their Pilots. They even went the extra mile to go over the take out with us, looking at satellite images and gave us a laminated placard with take out and contact details. Just great service and very experienced pilots and management. Thanks so much!!

My friend & I decided on a very short & last minute trip to AK and decided we wanted to go bear viewing in katmai while there. Unfortunately we weren’t able to book with Regal air because of the short notice, but they were truly so helpful and responsive. They recommended other companies and exchanged multiple emails with me to try and accommodate us. I would recommend just based on their customer service!

Awesome bear watching experience! Grant was amazing. Gave us a great tour and knew all the places to see the bears. The tour was spectacular. We saw many bears in the distance and a moma and baby at a safe distance. Went to Silver Salmon Lake Clark National Park where a ranger was cleaning clams. Had a great lunch also.

From the minute I started emailing them they were professional and spot on! This was a huge bucket list item for me and did they deliver. Devon our pilot was amazing some commercial pilots could take lessons from him. If you want to see bears, don't hesitate to fly with them, they were absolutely amazing.

A really great flight 😄! We flew out to Denali but it was cloudy and instead went up to Ruth Glacier. Yes it's named after my sister! But anyways our pilot was really great and I would fly with him again! Great pictures, however I didn't see any wildlife! Maybe I will bring banaculars next time 😀
